name: 岭南花窗
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: illustrated background artwork for a Chinese hotpot tile-puzzle mobile game. Background only.
Primary request: Create a NEW premium rich handpainted casual-game background named 岭南花窗, a heritage Cantonese restaurant with brilliantly colored stained-glass transom and finely carved teak. Use the input images only as composition and rendering references. Exactly tall portrait aspect 720:1520 (equivalent to reference 863:1824), edge-to-edge image.
Input images: image 1 reference for high quality tactile stylized game illustration and empty play area; image 2 reference for layout and scale. Design an entirely different architectural setting.
Scene: Old Cantonese restaurant stained-glass transom across upper 0-14%, strongly recognizable emerald and cobalt small geometric panes with golden amber highlights, ornate carved dark reddish teak borders and subtly arched transom silhouette. Narrow matching carved geometric window/lattice strips along extreme left and right edges. A few lush banana leaves and brilliant magenta bougainvillea flowers confined to edge zones. Large light ivory matte porcelain/plaster empty playing wall in the center. Bottom 26.5% is a reddish teak tabletop. A detailed warm copper hotpot with red broth cropped bottom-left. At lower-right a blue-white porcelain tea cup and cylindrical chopsticks holder, perhaps a few restrained tea leaves. Keep table center quiet and unobstructed.
Composition constraints: Preserve reference vertical layout: richly decorative architectural header y0-14%; LARGE EMPTY evenly light center x10-90%, y16-73.5%; all prop decoration strictly confined to extreme side strips x0-9% and x91-100%; tabletop starts y73.5%, props at far lower corners. Center must be a continuous light flat playing surface, no room perspective, no horizon, no furniture, no food or strong glass reflections in the center. Edge lighting may be softly tinted, but center stays warm ivory.
Style and lighting: glossy carved teak, translucent colored glass panels visibly luminous and tactile, painted ceramic glaze, premium polished handpainted 3D casual mobile game illustration, warm sunlight, soft dimensional shading, delicious copper glow, high detail material rendering matching reference. Rich emerald, cobalt, amber architecture plus ivory center and reddish wood. Must be visually distinct from the green cloth-curtain design: absolutely no silk or fabric curtain, no bamboo awning.
Absolute exclusions: NO TEXT or letters anywhere, NO logos, NO UI, NO buttons, NO tiles, NO food icons, NO phone or device frame, NO tray, NO menus, NO labels, NO center objects, NO flat vector art, NO photorealism, NO panel borders. Only one background illustration.
